# Feature: Ice bridge — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #50 (Ice bridge) from Terrain and Hazards before it is used in real levels. Effect: melts if you stand still on it. Unique: breaks from standing still, not from crossing it. Useful: a keep-moving crossing where waiting is the danger. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** melts if you stand still on it.

**So that** a keep-moving crossing where waiting is the danger.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Ice bridge for the first time in its teaching room (mech-50-ice-bridge-room). Teaching moment: First room: a shallow crossing already bridged by an ice block, with the far bank in full view. A player who stops on the bridge to consider the room melts through it and is returned to the checkpoint, which teaches that standing still, rather than crossing, is what the bridge cannot survive. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Not placed directly: it forms when an ice block is pushed into a shallow water tile
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: You can walk on it, but standing still on it for a full move melts it, you fall, and you return to your checkpoint
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It also melts if fire spreads next to it

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Not placed directly: it forms when an ice block is pushed into a shallow water tile
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Ice bridge's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-50-ice-bridge-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/terrain-and-hazards.yml mechanic #50.
